preservationNote: The complete original report is preserved as canonical JSON. sourceAuditSha256 is historical byte provenance; reportCanonicalSha256 verifies the parsed report content independently of formatting. The report predates schema-v3 acceptance: its descriptions of draft states and the then-unavailable AI schema remain historical, not current dispositions. This archival copy records no new acceptance, source retrieval or illustration inspection.

acceptanceLimits: Empty clearedTrainingConstraints are preserved for every candidate.
Historical shoulder-friendly or lower-back-easier coaching is not a clearance.
No fatigueScore, rep range, modality equivalence or difficulty-to-complexity conversion is newly validated here.
No band-only Chest horizontal-push or Shoulders vertical-push variant is supplied by the existing reviewed corpus.
Current schema allows draft/approved, not a distinct alpha AI acceptance state. Owner authorization must not be represented as fictitious human inspection.

An authorized relationship to pending metadata does not block intrinsic source acceptance, but cannot grant eligibility exceptions, capability evidence or substitution eligibility until the relevant endpoints are independently accepted and satisfy all other runtime requirements. Relationship history is retained; acceptance is not inherited.

boundaries: No approval or production-flag mutation is authorized by this report.
Preserve all 302 browse/manual records, including excluded and unresolved IDs.
Do not invent per-ID rep ranges, clearedTrainingConstraints, fixtures, variants or relationships.
Equipment categories still require the exact recorded station, attachment, configuration and quantity; generic Machine, Cable or Bench ownership is insufficient proof.
The 101 candidates carrying legacy programming are not a separately certified dosing cohort.
The 81 candidates without programming are categorical-only candidates; no exercise-specific prescription is supplied by this audit.

Relationship authorization is distinct from endpoint acceptance. Runtime must independently fail closed on acceptance of the relevant endpoints and all other eligibility requirements; an authorized edge to pending metadata cannot grant an eligibility exception, capability evidence or substitution eligibility.
candidatePolicy.meaning: Candidate for explicit owner-authorized alpha categorical acceptance, not current APPROVED status or clinical approval.
selection: Withhold three ankle-attachment gaps and one unresolved cross-record support-policy inconsistency.

Evaluate intrinsic source acceptance independently of relationship authorization and endpoint acceptance. An authorized relationship to a pending endpoint does not withhold an otherwise intrinsically supported source.

C1.finding: Each recorded observation explicitly requires an ankle strap, but metadata requires only Cable. The corpus withholds machine-glute-kickback for this same missing separate accessory.
C1.requiredDecision: Establish an explicit source-bound attachment requirement or keep withheld. Do not silently reuse a band-specific attachment token or assume Cable includes a cuff.

C2.finding: Unbanded fire-hydrant is unsupported while the otherwise comparable grounded hand/knee banded variant explicitly counts that grounded contact as required support.
C2.requiredDecision: Resolve the support convention explicitly. This is a policy-consistency hold, not proof of different anatomy or a prescription to choose a value automatically.

C3.authority: Owner-supplied authoritative product rule in the 2026-09-12 audit-refinement request.
C3.finding: The authoritative product rule separates relationship authorization from endpoint acceptance. An otherwise intrinsically supported source may be AI-accepted while an authorized relationship targets pending metadata; the relationship cannot confer endpoint acceptance.
C3.qualification: These seven sources return to the candidate cohort without quarantining or deleting authorized relationships. The three ankle-attachment gaps and fire-hydrant intrinsic hold remain pending. Runtime endpoint-acceptance enforcement is a required product boundary, not a newly implemented or verified runtime change.

relationshipHistory.preservation: No graph decision, rationale, comparison or endpoint digest was changed or deleted. Existing ledger graphDecisions remain authoritative historical records, bound by the unchanged ledger and metadata hashes.
relationshipHistory.supersededHoldStatus: Historical audit reasons only; none of these seven IDs remains pending solely because of a relationship endpoint.

runtimeRule.rule: Preserve relationship authorization and history, but fail closed on the relevant source and target acceptance checks before any eligibility exception, inherited evidence or eligible substitution. Pending endpoints remain pending even when their source is accepted. Candidate designation in this report is not actual endpoint acceptance.

C4.finding: Ten existing programming equipment contracts disagree with the current source-bound reviewed equipment contract.
references: ledger entry for each ID: illustrationObservation, corrections and limitations
C4.requiredDecision: Choose an authoritative setup contract before using legacy programming for alpha availability. Do not overwrite legacy ranges, progression or alternatives as an incidental categorical acceptance.
C4.specialQuantityLimit: bench-dip requires two support surfaces; the Bench token does not encode quantity.

C5.finding: Legacy movementPattern is isolation; reviewed movementPattern is horizontal_pull.
C5.requiredDecision: Keep these distinct contracts explicit or resolve taxonomy during migration. Neither category is newly established as a scientific fact by schema validity.

examples: review.graphIntegration.criticalHolds describes pull-ups -> negative-pull-up and side-plank -> plank as currently present; neither is emitted now.
Earlier crunch, decline-push-up and step-up correction strings mention Box alternatives subsequently removed.
C6.finding: Some summary/correction prose describes historical states rather than current emitted data.
references: ledger entries crunch, decline-push-up and step-up: corrections
C6.requiredTreatment: Use current metadata arrays, endpoint-bound graphDecisions and latest reconciliations. Do not replay chronological correction strings or supersededGraphNarrative as patches.

internallySupportedFacts.allAuthoredProposals: All 211 satisfy the current schema and importer normalization, match bundled metadata and have current ledger digests.
internallySupportedFacts.allCanonicalIds: Catalog, upstream source IDs and ledger coverage reconcile exactly; 302 unique entries, each retaining three source and bundled frame references.
internallySupportedFacts.capabilitySupportImpact: Assessed against each recorded observation and current corrections. These categorical mappings are product judgments; they do not establish medical or quantitative risk claims.

clearedTrainingConstraints.requiredTreatment: Preserve every empty list. Do not infer clearances from muscles, equipment, complexity, low impact, historical consensus or this audit.

directPrimary.qualification: Source-label agreement supports attribution, not biological exclusivity or suitability.

equipment.qualification: A source equipment label is not proof of complete setup. Three ready Cable-only proposals omit recorded ankle attachments.

prescriptionShape.qualification: Type agreement does not resolve a contradictory illustrated identity.

internallySupportedFacts.provenance: All proposals remain AI-authored drafts with null reviewerRole and reviewedAtEpochMillis. Schema-v2 digest refresh was bookkeeping, not renewed inspection.

relationships.qualification: Current endpoint digests, capability comparisons and emitted adjacency reconcile. Structural validity is not equivalence or approval. Four retained links currently target pending records.

internallySupportedFacts.secondaryMuscles: Every proposed secondary is represented by current catalog muscles or importer aliases. Secondary muscles remain descriptive, without fractional set credit.

legacyProgrammingAccounting.fallbackWarning: The current factory contains goal-based/default ranges. Those defaults must not be reported as exercise-specific evidence supplied by this ledger.
legacyProgrammingAccounting.qualification: Existing ranges, fatigue scores, coaching and legacy alternatives are not ratified by categorical metadata readiness. Missing programming is not a schema failure of reviewed metadata.
